title: Position the Work and Choose the Next Opportunity

blocks.title: Position the same verified work
blocks.text: Use the Truth Test: demonstrate, explain, support wording, and provide evidence. Create the four formats without changing the supported truth. Map three opportunities, choose primary and backup, and define one thirty-day evidence-building action.

SUPPLIED FICTIONAL TRAINING CASE: The reviewed intake prototype has retained tabletop checks for complete input, a missing date, and absent approval, plus revision and demonstration evidence. It supports describing a bounded design and review contribution. It does not establish enterprise consulting, universal automation, live customer delivery, savings, actual organizational permission, a credential, or a guaranteed opportunity. The example compares proposed current-setting, adjacent, and longer-term options; review roles and permission still need to be established.

Supplied fictional 75-word introduction: I designed and reviewed a fictional intake prototype that makes missing information and human approval visible. I used AI to help draft explanations and suggest checks, then inspected the outputs, corrected unsupported claims, and retained test notes. My demonstration shows a normal request and a review exception. This work supports a bounded design example, not live business performance. My next step is to seek permitted review and build evidence for a carefully limited internal pilot.

Supplied fictional 40-word profile: I design and review bounded AI assisted workflow examples. My fictional intake prototype includes visible gaps, human approval, test notes, and revision evidence. I explain AI support and personal decisions clearly. Live delivery, savings, and organizational permission remain unestablished here.
